verification.scope: Mechanical schema/count/taxonomy/identity correspondence, scoring/reversal and exact diagnostic bindings only; no semantic acceptance.

riskResolutions.i006: Clarified queued acknowledgement versus terminal referral outcome.

riskResolutions.i001: Changed payload under a committed operation ID is a conflict, not a retry of the original payload.
